description: Manually curated retrieval cases for Lenny's Podcast corpus. Expected sources are episode directory names under episodes/ in ChatPRD/lennys-podcast-transcripts.
metric: retrieval relevance: share of cases where an expected source appears in the top-k retrieved chunks

measured.corpus: 303 documents, 9842 chunks, all embedded with nomic-embed-text
measured.caveat: The on-corpus figure is a STRICT proxy, not the PRD relevance metric. It asks whether one specific pre-chosen episode appears in the top 8; several 'misses' returned defensibly relevant chunks from a different episode. Judging actual chunk relevance needs a human pass, which has not been done.
